<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-api-reference.ts from sdk/openapi.json. Do not edit — including in Studio; the next build replaces this file. -->

::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/emails/templates"}
#docs
Every email type, including ones never customised — those return the built-in with `customized: false`.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `list`. One of `list`. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The email templates. |
| `data.object` | `string` | The object type; always `email_template`. One of `email_template`. |
| `data.id` | `string` | Null when this is the built-in — no override row exists. |
| `data.type` | `string` | The email type this template is for. |
| `data.subject` | `string` | The subject line of the email. |
| `data.heading` | `string` | The heading at the top of the email. |
| `data.body` | `string` | The body text of the email. |
| `data.footer` | `string` | This email's own footer, same syntax and HTML subset as body. Null or empty uses the business footer (`email_config.footerNote`), else the built-in one. |
| `data.cta_label` | `string` | Button text override. Null keeps `default_cta_label`. |
| `data.show_facts` | `boolean` | False hides the facts card. |
| `data.block_order` | `array of string` | Order of the movable sections, each exactly once. Null = body, action, facts, footer. |
| `data.default_cta_label` | `string` | The engine's button label; null when this email never has a button. |
| `data.has_facts` | `boolean` | Whether this email ever has a facts card. |
| `data.default_footer` | `string` | What a null `footer` uses: the business footer (`email_config.footerNote`), else the built-in one. |
| `data.built_in` | `object` | The built-in subject, heading and body, for resetting a draft to the default. |
| `data.customized` | `boolean` | False = the built-in. Improvements to built-ins reach these businesses automatically. |
| `data.variables` | `array of object` | Merge variables the engine populates for this type. |
| `data.attachments` | `object` | This business's attachment rule for this email: business config, not template wording, changed through `email_config.attachments`. Null when the email is about no document. |
| `data.updated_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the email template was last changed (ISO-8601 UTC). |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Success |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/emails/templates" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```

#response
```json [200 OK]
{
  "object": "list",
  "data": [
    {
      "object": "email_template",
      "type": "invoice_issued",
      "subject": "Your invoice from Brightwater Analytics",
      "heading": "Thanks for your business",
      "body": "Requested by the customer.",
      "customized": false
    }
  ]
}
```
